name: Stage 37: Nävekvarn to Lilla Uttervik
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 37, Nävekvarn to Lilla Uttervik.
utilities: Nävekvarn/Gula Kvarn has the official start, parking, bus 561 access toward Nyköping, and nearby harbour/camping/food/lodging services. Most services are seasonal or opening-hour dependent.

Lilla Uttervik is a quiet stage junction with stage 38 rather than a service node. The closest researched bus access is north of the endpoint at Laggarbo/Syrtorpsvägen, about 1.8-1.9 km away, and the area may rely on sparse/pre-booked N07 complement traffic rather than reliable walk-up service; Nyköping C is the distant train anchor.
Skeppsvik and Sjöskogen provide useful intermediate access/parking and swimming/rest context, but they should be treated as local access nodes rather than full-service trailheads.

Svartåhällen is the only verified on-stage shelter/rest/fires cluster. The dry toilet is mapped and listed by older route sources, but Länsstyrelsen currently marks the Sjöskogen toilet as closed until a later opening update.
waterSources: No verified potable water source was found directly on stage 37 after leaving Nävekvarn. Carry water.
Nävekvarn harbour/camping has mapped/seasonal service water; verify access and season before relying on it.

Bråviken/coastal water and any small streams are not drinking-water sources. If continuing onto stage 38, the Uttervik water-treatment-plant tap is the next stronger official refill context, beyond stage 37.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden, Naturkartan, and the long-distance passport list stage 37 as 6.5 km, while the current local route geometry measures about 5.8 km, OSM relation 3821822 measures about 5.93 km, and third-party route pages land around 5.8-5.9 km. Keep the official 6.5 km and treat the mapped line as plausible but slightly shorter.
Naturkartan grades the stage red/demanding. Although short, it has road walking, a steep climb toward Fyrberget, rocky/coastal forest, cliffs, crevices, and repeated small climbs through Sjöskogen.

No active official fault report was found on the stage page during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Official comments mention 2024 signage confusion near the road turn toward Fyrberget/Sjöskogen; a 2025 stage-maintainer reply says poles/signage should be present, but the app should still add a map cue when leaving the road.

Some third-party loop/app tracks around Nävekvarn, Stage 37:1 and the larger Nävekvarn-Ålbäck coast loop can disagree with current Sörmlandsleden markings and may route onto old/disused wet or windthrow-affected lines. For the direct Stage 37 hike, follow current orange markings and official signage rather than old loop lines.

Topology: stage 37 connects back to stage 36 at Nävekvarn and forward to stage 38 at Lilla Uttervik. For exact route-builder stitching, snap west to OSM node 469855061 at 58.630521,16.800300 and east to OSM node 2789309812 at 58.622832,16.868308; keep official Gula Kvarn and Stage 38 coordinates as signed trailhead/context points.

Branch stage 37:1 starts from Nävekvarn/Gula Kvarn and should appear as a branch option when the user selects this area. Its OSM start is only about 23 m from the Stage 37/36 junction, but relation 9631219 has a tiny internal break near 58.6413,16.7957 if OSM geometry is used directly.

Sjöskogen has an internal local choice: the coastal path or a northern path around the hill toward Svartåhällen. Model this later as a Stage 37 variant choice rather than a separate hike; both reconnect at/near Svartåhällen.

Fyrberget and Sjöskogen reserve rules prohibit damaging or removing living/dead wood and restrict collecting plants/fungi/lichens, with ordinary berries and edible mushrooms allowed for personal use. Organized camps/competitions require permission.

Fires in Sjöskogen should use the prepared fireplaces at Svartåhällen/the shelter. Länsstyrelsen says to bring your own wood; do not collect dead or living wood in the reserve, and check current fire bans. During stricter fire bans even fixed grill places can be prohibited.
The Sjöskogen/Svartåhällen dry toilet is a known facility, but Länsstyrelsen currently lists the toilet as closed until an opening update. Treat it as status-sensitive, not guaranteed.
No dedicated wild campsite was found on stage 37. Use Nävekvarn camping for certainty; elsewhere follow allemansrätten, local signs, and reserve restrictions.

facilities.name: Gula Kvarn / Nävekvarn trailhead
facilities.description: Official stage 37 start at Magasinet Gula Kvarn, with parking nearby and connections to stage 36 and branch 37:1.

facilities.name: Nävekvarn bus stop
facilities.description: Closest regular bus at the start, usually route 561 toward/from Nyköping busstation; check current Sörmlandstrafiken service.

facilities.name: Gula Kvarn / Nävekvarn parking
facilities.description: Parking near the official start. Check local signs and capacity before leaving a car.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Nearest practical rail anchor, roughly 18 km from Nävekvarn and 16.6 km from Lilla Uttervik; use bus, taxi, bike, or pickup for the trailheads.

facilities.name: Nävekvarns skärgårdscamping
facilities.description: Formal paid camping/service option near the harbour and Parkbadet, useful before or after the stage; verify season and booking.

facilities.name: Nävekvarn harbour services
facilities.description: Guest-harbour service cluster with toilets/showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, restaurant/café, fuel and small-shop context in local guide material. Seasonal/opening-hour dependent.

facilities.name: Nävekvarn harbour/camping water
facilities.description: Mapped drinking-water point near the harbour/camping area. Treat as seasonal/service-dependent and verify access before relying on it.

facilities.name: Parkbadet Nävekvarn
facilities.description: Bathing area near the early route/Fyrberget access, with jetty/play/picnic context and municipal bathing-water sampling. Not a drinking-water source.

facilities.name: Parkbadet / Nävekvarn harbour toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet by the harbour/Parkbadet service area, useful before starting or after finishing locally; opening and season may vary.

facilities.name: Brådhes Livs & Deli
facilities.description: Local grocery/deli close to the trailhead. Useful for start-side supplies, but verify current hours before depending on it.

facilities.name: Systrarna Brådhes café/restaurant
facilities.description: Seasonal/opening-hour-dependent café, harbour restaurant, and local service context in Nävekvarn; verify hours.

facilities.name: Marinans Guesthouse
facilities.description: Nearby lodging in Nävekvarn; verify current operation and booking.

facilities.name: Fyrberget/Sjöskogen turn cue
facilities.description: Reported wayfinding ambiguity from a 2024 stage-page comment when leaving the road/Skeppsviksvägen toward Fyrberget/Sjöskogen. Maintainer replied in 2025 that poles/signage should be present, but hikers should watch orange markings here.

facilities.name: Fyrberget reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve marker. Do not damage/remove living or dead wood; collecting is restricted to allowed berries, edible mushrooms and flowers for personal use; organized camps/competitions require permission.

facilities.name: Fyrberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Steep climb after the road section; viewpoint over Bråviken with table/benches nearby. Short but punchy terrain with roots/rock, especially when wet.

facilities.name: Skeppsviksgruvorna / old mining remains
facilities.description: Approximate Fyrberget-area heritage context: medieval mining remains and nearby ancient cairn. Treat as look-but-do-not-disturb heritage.

facilities.name: Skeppsvik swimming and loop access
facilities.description: Bathing/parking access and start context for Sjöskogsberget runt. Treat as local access/rest context rather than a full service point.

facilities.name: Sjöskogen / Svartåstigen parking
facilities.description: Access parking for the 900 m accessible trail to Svartåhällen; official Sjöskogsberget runt GPS is N 58°37.410' E 016°50.226'. Verify local signs.

facilities.name: Sjöskogen route choice
facilities.description: Internal Stage 37 choice in Sjöskogen: coastal path or northern path around the hill toward Svartåhällen. Show as a route variant/optional dashed line, not a separate hike entry.

facilities.name: Sjöskogen reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules: no damaging/removing living or dead wood or wreck parts; no introducing foreign species; collecting plants/fungi/lichens is restricted; organized camps/competitions require permission. Watch steep drops and deep rock crevices.

facilities.name: Sjöskogsberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Reserve high point and rough coastal-forest viewpoint area, with demanding terrain and Bråviken views.

facilities.name: Svartåhällen shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest area after about 3.5 km, by Bråviken in Sjöskogen and close to the accessible trail from Svartåstigen.

facilities.name: Svartåhällen physical lean-to
facilities.description: OSM physical shelter/lean-to node near the official Svartåhällen rest-area coordinate; use the official point for route planning and this point for map detail.

facilities.name: Svartåhällen fireplaces
facilities.description: Prepared fireplaces/grill areas at or near the shelter and shore. New fireplaces were confirmed by Länsstyrelsen in June 2025; bring your own wood and check fire bans.

facilities.name: Svartåhällen shore fireplace
facilities.description: Additional prepared shore-side fireplace/rest point in Sjöskogen. Bring your own wood; do not collect reserve wood.

facilities.name: Svartåhällen dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet by the shelter/rest area, but Länsstyrelsen currently lists the Sjöskogen toilet as temporarily closed until an opening update. Verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Svartåhällen picnic/rest area
facilities.description: Coastal picnic/rest context near the shelter/fireplace cluster and Bråviken shore.

facilities.name: Bjurvik rock viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate viewpoint west of Bjurvik mentioned in reserve context.

facilities.name: Lilla Uttervik / old smithy
facilities.description: OSM topology endpoint shared with stage 38; official stage 38 marker is about 42 m away. Official text mentions an old smithy near the endpoint.

facilities.name: Lilla Uttervik parking/access
facilities.description: Stage 38 notes parking on stage 37 about 200 m before the stage board; coordinate is inferred/approximate, verify local signs.

facilities.name: Syrtorpsvägen bus stop
facilities.description: Nearest researched bus access north of Lilla Uttervik, about 1.8-1.9 km from the endpoint; verify timetable.

facilities.name: Laggarbo bus stop
facilities.description: Alternative bus access north of the Lilla Uttervik end, about 1.9 km away; verify current service.

facilities.name: Uttervik N07 complement traffic
facilities.description: End-side public transport may rely on sparse pre-booked N07 complementary traffic for Uttervik/Ålbäck/Hummelvik, with limited weekday patterns and small capacity. Verify live planner and book-ahead rules before relying on it.

facilities.name: Uttervik water tap on stage 38
facilities.description: Official year-round tap at the water treatment plant on stage 38, beyond Lilla Uttervik. Show only as continuation context from stage 37.
